title: Verification expiry and revocation gate on the authoritative assignment write path
method: Regressions written and observed RED before any production change, then GREEN after.
red_before: 13 cases: 12 failed, 1 passed. The single pass was F53X-11, which asserts that Grooming, Sitting and Boarding are NOT given new universal requirements - correctly green from the start, because it asserts an absence of change.

rules_implemented.1_walking_taxi_police_mandatory: The policy validator refuses a configured Dog Walking or Pet Taxi requirement set without police_verification, and setCategoryMandate is validated against the same floor BEFORE anything is written, so a refused mandate leaves both surfaces untouched rather than half-applied.
rules_implemented.2_no_universal_requirement: The floor is scoped to those two categories only. Grooming keeps [aadhaar, pan], Pet Sitting [aadhaar, pan, address], Boarding [aadhaar, pan, house_verification, pet_proofing_photo] - asserted exactly, so a future widening fails the test.
rules_implemented.3_operator_narrowing_authoritative: setCategoryMandate still writes through to the policy the gate reads, so a narrowed mandate is what is enforced. F53X-12 narrows dog_walker to [aadhaar, police_verification] and then proves an assignment succeeds on exactly that set.
rules_implemented.4_write_time_eligibility: assertProviderAssignable runs inside insertReservations and inside createAssignmentOffer. A check counts only when status='verified' AND it has not lapsed.
rules_implemented.5_immediate_removal: revokeProviderVerification sets live=0 and status='verification_hold' on provider_capacity_profiles - the row loadGovernedProviders reads - so new matching stops at once rather than at the next sweep.
rules_implemented.6_in_progress_work_preserved: A revocation opens Operations recovery cases and changes nothing else. Booking, work order, payment and proof are all asserted unchanged after a revocation on an in_service job.
rules_implemented.7_scheduled_work_recovered: A scheduled but not-started reservation keeps its row and its status, and a provider_recovery_cases row with reason_code 'provider_verification_revoked' is opened against it. Further acceptance is stopped because the offer write is gated.
rules_implemented.8_non_mandatory_expiry_ignored: Only requiredTypes gate assignment. An expired `pan` on a dog walker - not in the approved Walking set - does not block, proved by an assignment that still succeeds.
rules_implemented.9_governed_return: TWO deliberate steps, neither automatic. Renewing a document re-lists nobody. clearProviderVerificationHold refuses while any mandatory check is still not current, and when it succeeds it sets status back to uat_ready while LEAVING live=0 - the existing addProviderToServiceMap is what puts the provider back in front of customers.

why_the_gate_is_at_write_time: A matching-read filter alone loses the race. A request that reads a valid provider, decides, and commits after a revocation lands would still write the assignment. So the provider's standing is part of the INSERT itself - `AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provider_capacity_profiles WHERE id=? AND live=1 AND status='active')` - the same shape the capacity and travel-buffer guards already use. When that guard refuses, the route re-checks and answers with the verification refusal rather than a misleading SLOT_TAKEN, so a customer is never told to retry a provider who must not be assigned at all.

the_one_permissive_answer_stated_plainly.what: A provider with NO onboarding application has no verification records to judge. providerAssignmentBlock reports evaluated:false and does not block.
the_one_permissive_answer_stated_plainly.why: The seeded UAT capacity profiles are exactly this shape and predate the onboarding pipeline. Blocking them would take every seeded provider off the platform rather than close a hole.
the_one_permissive_answer_stated_plainly.how_it_is_visible: The verdict carries evaluated:false and the reason `no_onboarding_verification_record` rather than pretending it passed, and the policy field `blockProvidersWithoutVerificationRecord` turns it into a block - configuration in Control Center, per service and city.
the_one_permissive_answer_stated_plainly.recommended_follow_up: Backfill onboarding applications for the seeded providers, then set blockProvidersWithoutVerificationRecord to true so the gate is total.

files_changed: lib/provider-verification-mandate.ts - additive nullable provider_verifications.expires_at; new recordVerificationValidity; INVALID_VERIFICATION_STATUSES; setCategoryMandate validated against the policy floor before writing
lib/provider-verification-policy.ts - police floor for the two custody verticals; blockProvidersWithoutVerificationRecord
lib/provider-assignment-eligibility.ts (new) - providerAssignmentBlock, assertProviderAssignable, filterAssignableProviders, revokeProviderVerification, clearProviderVerificationHold
lib/provider-capacity-governance.ts - loadGovernedProviders filters on verification standing; createAssignmentOffer is gated
app/api/uat-scheduling/route.ts - assertProviderAssignable at write time, provider standing bound into the reservation INSERT, and an accurate refusal when that guard rejects
sabotage_verification: Write-time gate removed from the reservation -> the race case fails (the read filter still catches 1-3).
SQL guard removed, pre-check kept -> the race case fails: a pre-check is not a write-time guarantee.
Expiry ignored, status alone consulted -> the expired case fails alone.
Revocation cancels the work instead of preserving it -> the in-progress case fails alone.
MATCHING READ filter removed, write gate intact -> 13/13 still pass: the write-time gate alone is sufficient.
BOTH removed (the original defect) -> 4 cases fail.
non_vacuity_controls: a fully valid provider still receives assignments
a non-mandatory document expiring does not block
Grooming, Sitting and Boarding keep exactly their existing mandates
an operator-narrowed mandate is satisfied by exactly the narrowed set

gates.focused: 54/54 across the four verification and onboarding suites
gates.dog_walking_shortcut: not reintroduced - every fixture in this suite clears the approved checks explicitly
gates.merge_or_deploy: none - work is committed to ptja/audit-fixes and pushed; no merge, no PR, no deployment
